summary: Red drum, or redfish, is a copper-coloured coastal fish best recognised by dark spots near the tail. Young fish use inshore waters before joining nearshore populations as they grow. Spawning adults make drumming sounds using muscles associated with their swim bladder.

features: Copper to bronze sides and a paler belly
Usually one or more dark spots at the tail base

habitat.description: Inshore and nearshore water, including seagrass, sand or mud bottoms and oyster bars.

eating: Florida wildlife authorities describe red drum as a valued table fish.
